intro: Dogran's Captivity is a vital trial in an aspiring Horde warlock's training, sending practitioners into the heart of a quilboar camp to rescue a captured orc warrior. Entrusted with a revitalizing concoction, the warlock must locate the battered Grunt Dogran and supply him with the strength needed to escape his captors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've made it this far, so if you want to see this through to the end, I won't stop you. I can't spare you any additional manpower though, you'll be on your own.
Dogran is being held in a quilboar camp to the north of here. Look for a group of two huts. He'll be heavily guarded—that is, if they haven't killed him yet, or he hasn't succumbed to his wounds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can feel the strength in me now, enough to hobble away... But my leg, I will have lost it for the rest of my life. My arm, too.
